lines.1: 「Man, I just can't get into Saturday practice.」
lines.2: 「The fact that you still show up makes you pretty damn conscientious.」
lines.3: 「What were you doing on Dobuzaka? Don't tell me you're trying to pick up foreign girls again.」
lines.4: 「I was just checking the date of a live show.」
lines.5: 「Kufushuuu! I have appeeeared! Are there any weak little children heeere?!」
lines.6: 「What the hell is that stupid outfit? Seriously, I might kill you.」
lines.7: 「The Regional Tuna Yokai: an intelligent monster that yearns to adapt to humanity and has blended seamlessly into modern society.」
lines.8: 「But it resents the constraints of human life, like oppression from its boss, so it bullies the weak to blow off steam and then goes home. A cunning yokai indeed.」
lines.10: 「No, that thing is just plain awful.」
lines.11: 「To drive it away, when it appears, just say, 'Mr. Tuna, I do karate,' and it'll get scared and run off.」
lines.12: 「And where are you going in that ridiculous costume?」
lines.13: 「I'm going to storm Leo's room and scare him.」
lines.14: 「He's an idiot, so he'll be terrified.」
lines.16: 「I'll take a picture of Leo cowering. Then we can all laugh at him and scar him emotionally.」
lines.17: 「Is it just me, or are you two barely having the same conversation?」
lines.18: 「Why are you so obsessed with revenge, anyway?」
lines.19: 「He scared me half to death yesterday. So I'm paying him back by scaring him.」
lines.20: 「More importantly, I woke up abandoned in the damp courtyard this morning. That's reason enough! He should treat me with more care!!」
lines.21: 「Is it really okay for a yokai to come out in the middle of the afternoon?」
lines.22: 「The Regional Tuna Yokai appears on peaceful afternoons, in quiet residential neighborhoods, and targets people who live alone.」
